versions.changelog:
Initial release of Morrisons Shop Skill.

- Search and add grocery products to your Morrisons trolley by exact or fuzzy match.
- View current basket contents and total cost at any time.
- List, create, rename, and delete shopping lists; add or remove specific items from lists; transfer list items to your trolley.
- Fetch and view previous orders with full itemized details, including delivery status and receipts.
- See available delivery slots, reserve a slot, and check checkout status.
- Handle session authentication via saved browser state, direct login, or import of cookies.
- Requires Bun and Playwright for execution.
